name: s81sl_rs-s81sl_rs-COMMIT
purpose: S81 slice ring stop leaf ot_s81sl_rs (sibling of the x streamer leaf s81sl_xs3; replaces the s81sl_xg tile) to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0 + native audit); child of the slice parents s81dv_slice C1 / C3.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81sl_rs u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/v41rom/ot_v41_kreg.sv rtl/common/ot_prefix.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/slice/ot_s81sl_rs.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: rs_equiv_mutslice
bench.fail_regex: ^RS_CASE sid=0 seed=1 dens=40 FAIL expected=FAIL ok=1

bench.name: xg_lockstep
bench.cmd: bash tools/s81_slice/xg_bench.sh {RUN}/xg_lockstep L0_near_s5 L0_far_s0 L0_rand_s15 L2_near_s9 L2_rand_s3 L2_far_s14 L0_rand_s8 L0_offm1

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81sl_rs/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81sl_rs/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81sl_rs --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81sl_rs  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-XG3 (LEAD3-S81 10-19): the s81sl_xg tile (ring stop + x streamer, 38k flops on one root over 648 um; gates xgr CTS rc=137 / xgr2 DPL-0038 after 1.2M repair buffers, GPL overflow stuck 0.30) is split into two sibling hard leaves of the slice parent: this ring stop leaf ot_s81sl_rs and the x streamer leaf s81sl_xs3; ot_s81sl_xg is wiring only. ot_s81sl_rs = ot_s81sl_rstop RELAY=1 cycle-for-cycle (rs_equiv: 8 random protocol cases x 20k cycles, all outputs every edge, 0 mismatches; MUT_SLICE negative control FAILs), restructured as 46 bit slices of 24 b each with its own kept control copy (header pin-flop copies + fragment-state replicas) so no select drives more than ~24 b of the 1,104-b muxes; header bits [20:0] / scalar valids / faults from copy 0. g_d leaves on the S face in [49.68, 583.20] facing the x streamer leaf's N-face g_d range (same span), so the 3 x 1,031-b gather port is a straight registered abutment. SAFE checklist (owner 10-19): 1 pins waived-with-reason (source-registered: every input lands in a pin flop, every output leaves a relay flop; reset_landing 2 stages ON). 2 reach fixed: W pin -> E pin is iw flop -> line mux + ro_e_p -> ro_e_q relay (two hops of ~432 um at 864 wide). 3 fanout fixed: 46 kept control copies (ot_s81sl_rs_cc, keep_hierarchy, unparameterised so Yosys cannot rename it) each drive <= 24 b of every wide mux; reset via ot_rst_relay 4 regions. 4 depth PASS: 5:1 one-hot line mux + header format, no arithmetic beyond hops-1. 5 storage PASS: fragment slots 2 x 828 b written once per beat (no runtime index, no delay line). 6 floorplan waived-with-reason: pin-bound (no macros), outline from face pin density <= 5.8/um, not synthesis area. 7 clock: clock_split_km K=16 regional roots; spread judged TT+FF <= 80; io_hold_margin 0.03. 8 schedule: cycle-equal to ot_s81sl_rstop RELAY=1 (rs_equiv) -> no schedule change vs xgr.
